remarks: Discover comfortable living at the Fairlawn complex, ideally situated just minutes from downtown with easy access to I-95. This unit offers a generously sized bedroom with a convenient private rear entry. The layout features a bright, open living space that connects smoothly to the dining area and kitchen. Heat and Hot water included in HOA fee!  Additional highlights include on-site laundry, extra storage in the lower level, one assigned parking space, and plenty of guest parking.
